extDescription.message: Reads agreement documents so you don't have to. Highlights potentially unfavourable clauses before you accept.

scoreSublabel.message: Pattern detection only - not legal advice.

stateIdle.message: No analysis yet on this page.

sidepanelSetupNeeded.message: Assent needs a quick one-time setup before it can analyse pages.

stateUnsupportedLanguageBody.message: This document is not in English. Assent currently analyses English-language documents only. Support for other languages is planned.

errorNoDeviceAI.message: On-device language model is not ready on this device.

errorStuck.message: Analysis is taking too long. Please reload the page and try again.

errorNoAccess.message: Assent could not access this page. Click the Assent icon on the toolbar, then press Scan this page.

errorNoDocument.message: No agreement text was found on this page.

errorUnsupportedPage.message: This page can't be scanned. Open a normal web page and try again.

noticeLowRecall.message: We could not find verifiable clauses in the visible page text. The actual document may be hidden behind a tab, accordion, or paywall. Try expanding each section before opening this analysis.

noticeIncompleteContent.message: Only a small slice of the page was readable. The document may be lazy-loaded - expand each section before re-running analysis.

disclaimerBody.message: Output produced by automated pattern detection on the user's device. Each flag references a verbatim excerpt so it can be verified independently. This is not a legal opinion, not legal advice, and is not affiliated with the publisher of the analysed document. The score reflects language patterns only and may be incomplete or wrong. Always read the original document before agreeing.

donationTitle.message: This extension is independent and free

donationBody.message: No ads. No tracking. No data sold. If it has been useful, a small contribution helps keep development going.

footerAttribution.message: Open source · independent · not affiliated with any third party

catFlagDataResale.message: Personal data resale to undisclosed parties

catFlagBroadDataSharing.message: Broad data sharing with third parties

onbIntro.message: Assent analyses agreement documents entirely on your device using Chrome's built-in AI. Nothing you read is ever sent to a server.

onbPrivacyNote.message: 100% on-device · no data leaves your browser

onbReadyBody.message: The on-device model is ready. Open any terms, privacy, or agreement page and press "Scan this page" in the side panel.

onbDownloadableBody.message: Chrome needs to download its built-in AI model once (about 2 GB). It runs fully offline afterwards. This can take a few minutes depending on your connection.

onbDownloadingBody.message: You can leave this page open. This happens only once.

onbUnavailableBody.message: Your device does not currently meet the requirements for Chrome's built-in AI. Please check the following:

onbReqDisk.message: At least 22 GB of free space on the volume that holds your Chrome profile.

onbReqHardware.message: A GPU with more than 4 GB of VRAM (or a recent CPU with sufficient RAM).

onbReqOs.message: Windows 10/11, macOS 13+, Linux, or ChromeOS on a supported device.

onbFlagTitle.message: Advanced: force-enable on a capable device

onbFlagBody.message: If your hardware qualifies but the model still will not appear, open this flag, set it to Enabled, and restart Chrome:

onbUnsupportedBody.message: Assent needs desktop Chrome 148 or newer for the built-in Prompt API. Update Chrome and reopen this page.

onbDownloadFailed.message: The model download did not finish. Check your connection and free disk space, then try again.
